question: Should this fix intentionally invalidate Codex, Claude, Vertex, and Pi session cost caches on upgrade, or should rebuilding be limited to cache formats whose persisted offsets are affected by incomplete JSONL tails?
rationale: The diff deliberately changes several persisted artifact names and imposes upgrade-time rescanning; tests can verify mechanics but cannot establish the intended provider scope.

options.title: Confirm broad rebuild
options.body: Keep all version bumps and record that every affected cache must be rebuilt to discard potentially unsafe persisted offsets.

options.title: Narrow invalidation
options.body: Bump only artifacts whose scanners persist offsets affected by the JSONL tail behavior, with focused upgrade coverage for each retained bump.

recommendation.title: Confirm broad rebuild
recommendation.body: Keep all version bumps and record that every affected cache must be rebuilt to discard potentially unsafe persisted offsets.
